name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin learning to serve the Holy Light, you begin with humble charity rather than martial glory.
As an Alliance citizen, you see Stormwind’s struggle to support its orphans and the ties with Ironforge as people seek help amid economic strain.

aliases: what is the tome of divinity
why do the tome of divinity
faq.answer: The trial teaches aspiring paladins to serve the Holy Light through humble aid. Initiates seek someone in Stormwind who is pure of heart and needs help, rather than proving themselves in combat or through grand deeds.
faq.q: What is the purpose of The Tome of Divinity trial?

faq.answer: Stephanie Turner lives in Stormwind’s Trade District and sews clothing for children at the city’s orphanage. She depends on cloth and leather donations to provide for them.
Stephanie Turner’s husband has traveled to Ironforge to seek support for their work at the orphanage. While he is away, she gathers supplies and sews clothes in Stormwind.
faq.q: Why has Stephanie Turner's husband gone to Ironforge?

faq.answer: More tradesmen in Stormwind have increased competition for cloth and leather. With fewer people willing to donate those materials, Stephanie struggles to gather enough to make clothes for the orphans.
faq.q: What difficulties is Stephanie Turner facing?

aliases: why does the quest send you to stephanie
faq.answer: Stephanie Turner has noble intent, a pure heart, and a real need for help. Aiding her gives an initiate a chance to serve someone devoted to caring for others.
faq.q: Why does this trial specifically direct initiates to Stephanie Turner?

aliases: what does the light teach here
lesson of the tome of divinity
faq.answer: The trial teaches servants of the Light to show compassion and serve the vulnerable. Before using holy power in battle, they must learn to be kind to citizens in need.
faq.q: What lesson does this trial impart to servants of the Light?

sections.body: Initiates of the Light begin this sacred trial by walking Stormwind’s streets. They seek someone of noble intent and pure motive who depends on the kindness of strangers. Before deeper instruction in holy duties, they learn that service to the vulnerable matters more than glorious combat.
sections.title: A Lesson in Humility and Service

sections.body: In Stormwind’s Trade District, Stephanie Turner makes clothing for children in the city’s orphanage with her husband. More tradesmen have come to the city, and competition for cloth and leather has made donations harder to find. Her husband has gone to Ironforge to seek support. Stephanie remains in Stormwind, carrying on their work.
sections.title: Aid in the Trade District

summary: In Stormwind, initiates of the Light are sent to help someone in need. They seek a citizen of pure heart and noble motive, and find Stephanie Turner in the Trade District.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
